svg.title: Quality assurance pipeline
svg.desc: Every push or pull request starts these checks in parallel: Build matrix (every push / PR): 50+ compilers: G​CC, Clang, M​SVC, AppleClang, Intel, NVIDIA, ... C++11, 14, 17, 20, 23, and 26 libc++ and libstdc++ warnings: Clang -Weverything, G​CC 300+ warnings; Unit tests (doctest) (every push / PR): every public A​PI function every exception id and message all Unicode code points single header and split headers custom number, string, array, and object types; Coverage (every push / PR): unit tests cover all lines of the code base; Static analysis (every push / PR, scheduled): Clang-Tidy, Cppcheck, Infer Clang Static Analyzer (52 checkers), I​WYU, Codacy CodeQL, Semgrep, Flawfinder (also scheduled); Dynamic analysis (every push / PR): runtime assertions Valgrind (Memcheck) address and undefined behavior sanitizers, integer overflow, nullability violations; Fuzzing (every PR, continuous): CIFuzz on every pull request OSS-Fuzz: billions of inputs every crash fixed with a reproducing unit test; Style (every push / PR): Artistic Style (astyle), enforced in the C​I cpplint with 61 rules; Docs and examples (every push / PR, scheduled): every documentation example is tested; changed output fails site built with warnings as errors; links checked regularly (scheduled); Integration, supply chain (every push / PR, scheduled): CMake 3.5, 3.31.6, and 4.0.0 Meson, Swift Package Manager dependency review on every PR Dependabot daily, OpenSSF Scorecard, R​EUSE. When they pass, the change is merged into develop; a release is made only when no vulnerability alert is open.
svg.text: checks, run in parallel on GitHub Actions and AppVeyor
